bio: Mary, whose maiden name is not known, was the wife of William Davenport of Fordham. The Davenport family Bible, as reported in the Davenport genealogy, records her simply as Mary and lists her children Thomas, born in 1682, William, born in 1683, Francis, born in 1685, and Rachel. Through her daughter Jerusha Topping she is John's 9th-great-grandmother.
